## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 15-juan late-Qīng Chán lamp-record selection, compiled by three Qīng monks drawing on earlier lamp records and recorded-sayings literature to produce a more compact reference than the massive *Wǔdēng quánshū* ([KR6q0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0021)). Title — "Abbreviated Collection of the Orthodox Source" — announces its compendium character.

**Abstract**

One of the later-Qīng attempts to produce a condensed, practically-usable Chán lamp record selecting the most important figures and dialogues from the sprawling *Wǔdēng quánshū* ([KR6q0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0021)) and its Cáodòng-side competitor *Xùdēng zhèngtǒng* ([KR6q0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0027)). Relatively conservative in its lineage attributions; avoids the polemical edge of the seventeenth-century disputes.
